summary: T15-01 at d04283f meets all seven acceptance criteria. All seven listed checks passed when I ran them. The diff touches only files in the story's list. I found no weakened tests and no mock data reachable from production. I could not independently confirm that the tests were seen failing first.

checks.criterion: bundle:pull copies the small server-side JSONs listed in the manifest and never copies large artifacts
checks.evidence: The isPulledPath allow-list is at lib/bundle.ts:60-67. lib/bundle-files.test.ts:142-161 checks that only the server-side files are copied and that tiles, model, report and parquet files are neither read nor copied.

checks.criterion: SHA-256 and byte count are verified per file, naming the file. A file listed but missing fails the pull, and an unlisted file is not copied
checks.evidence: readListedFile at lib/bundle.ts:224-243 checks bytes and SHA-256. Tests at bundle-files.test.ts:187-209 cover every server-side path for sha256, byte count and listed-but-missing. The unlisted-file test is at lines 163-171. The error message contains release/<version>/<path>.

checks.criterion: Schema validation applies to manifest and validation only. Files without a schema are copied after the checksum check and reported as schema gaps, with no invented schema
checks.evidence: parseManifest and parseValidation use the @terraluna/schema schemas (lib/bundle.ts:255-285). checksumOnly holds raw bytes and is never parsed. scripts/bundle-pull.ts:44-49 prints 'have no schema ... yet', and the CLI test asserts it (test line 461).

checks.criterion: The loader exports typed accessors, a typed error, and the production mock guard as a function. Absent optional files read as 'not present'
checks.evidence: sourcesFile, targetsFile, comparisonFile and windowsTopNFile return a not_present or present result. BundleFileError and MockBundleError are exported. assertDeployable is exported (lib/bundle.ts:166). Tests at lines 300-335 and 337-400 cover these.
tests/bundle.test.ts (48 tests) and tests/bundle-pull-cli.test.ts (4 tests) are not in the diff and pass. All 161 tests pass across 6 files. The guard tests are at bundle-files.test.ts:402-440.

checks.criterion: Vitest tests are written first and seen failing, use temp directories, and do not depend on release/
checks.evidence: I did not re-run the tests against the pre-change code, so I could not see them failing first. The git log shows the test commits (6d96257, c041c3a) before the fix (9b94e56). The tests use tempDir() and repoWithMock() and never read release/.

checks.criterion: make web-build and make web-smoke still pass with the mock bundle, and tests are placed under lib/bundle*.test.ts
checks.evidence: The build succeeded and the smoke test printed its success line. lib/bundle-files.test.ts exists, vitest.config.ts includes lib/**/*.test.ts, and `vitest run lib/bundle` ran 81 tests, all passing.
ruff, mypy and turbo lint/typecheck all passed.
404 pytest tests, 161 web tests and 157 schema tests passed.

findings.claim: The accessors for the schema-gap files return raw bytes, not typed records. That matches the no-substitute-schema rule, but the API will have to parse these files itself once schemas exist.
findings.evidence: The SchemaGapFile type exposes only a Uint8Array. A follow-up that adds schemas should replace these accessors.

resolution.reason: AC3 requires this: files with no @terraluna/schema schema (sources, targets, comparisons, windows top-N) are "copied after the checksum check only", and "no hand-written substitute schema is added". PRD 8.5 says request and response schemas come from @terraluna/schema, and D23 says they are generated from the Python models. Parsing these files into typed records in apps/web would need exactly the substitute schema AC3 forbids. SchemaGapFile (lib/bundle.ts:96) keeps verified bytes and a present/not_present status so the API can still tell "not listed" apart from empty. The four gaps are recorded in the story notes, item (2), for a human decision. Once schema.py defines these records and make schema generates the zod modules, the story that adds them replaces these accessors. Nothing to change in T15-01.

findings.claim: A pull does not delete files left in data/ by an earlier pull. They are never read, because loadBundle only reads files the manifest lists, but they stay on disk.
findings.evidence: The pullBundle doc comment says an earlier pull's file that the manifest no longer lists is left in place.

resolution.reason: Leaving these files in place is intended, and they are never read. AC2 asks only that an unlisted file is not copied. pullBundle writes manifest.json last (lib/bundle.ts:410), and loadBundle reads only the paths the current manifest lists (readBundle -> pulledEntries, lib/bundle.ts:288-357), so a leftover file cannot be served. Test 32f520b pins this: after a full release pull and then a mock pull into the same directory, the release files are still on disk, yet sourcesFile, targetsFile, comparisonFile and windowsTopNFile all read not_present, and pulledPaths is [manifest.json, validation.json]. apps/web/data/ is git-ignored, so a Vercel build starts from a clean checkout. Deleting files under an outDir passed in by the caller would add a destructive step that no criterion asks for, and CLAUDE.md forbids destructive changes to data artifacts without authorization. Story notes item (4) records this choice.
